notes: Synthetic environment script lines with CRLF and LF endings: ref point counts including 255 (the count wraps and is reported), kinds 0-3, -1 and values whose low word is 1 or 2, names with spaces, with and without the closing parenthesis; 0xa4421, strlen, copy and fill run as original. The error hook at 0x132a74 points at a stack-argument logger; the allocator 0xe29e8, 0x2a7ac and 0x9ddfc are redirected by JMP to register loggers (0x2a7ac logs its EDX slot, both name callees log the first eight name bytes); the sscanf 0xdf26f runs as original.
